title: 中国宏观经济管理实践的一个理论总结：发展导向型宏观调控
title_zh: 中国宏观经济管理实践的一个理论总结：发展导向型宏观调控
title_primary: 中国宏观经济管理实践的一个理论总结：发展导向型宏观调控
authors: 冯明
official: 官方发布 2026-09-22 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 中国在改革开放以来特别是党的十八大以来的宏观经济管理实践中，逐步探索形成了一套有别于西方发达国家传统上以周期为导向的宏观政策的理念和做法，具有鲜明的以发展为导向的特征。本文从学理上将其提炼概括为“发展导向型宏观调控”，并构建了一个四象限分析框架刻画其理论内涵。与西方发达国家传统的单维度、局限于短期、侧重于需求侧的狭义周期导向型宏观政策不同，中国的发展导向型宏观调控具有总量和结构双维度、短期和中长期并重、兼顾供给侧与需求侧的特征。以周期为导向的西方传统宏观政策理论主要基于历史上发达国家的宏观政策实践，与广大发展中国家宏观经济管理的现实需要之间存在“鸿沟”；而发展导向型宏观调控源于中国这一世界上最大的发展中国家的成功实践，兼具促进经济持续增长、推动结构转型升级、化解重点领域供需失衡、平滑总量经济波动等综合职能，内涵更为丰富，包含并超越了狭义的逆周期宏观政策，更加适用于广大发展中国家的现实需要。这一标识性概念的提出，是在宏观经济领域以习近平经济思想为指导构建中国经济学自主知识体系的一种尝试，既是对中国过往宏观经济管理实践的理论总结，也对未来进一步完善宏观调控和健全宏观经济治理体系具有启示意义，同时有望为其他国家尤其是发展中国家的宏观经济管理提供一定参考借鉴。

title: Recent stock prices as reference points and the disposition effect
title_zh: 近期股价作为参考点与处置效应
title_primary: 近期股价作为参考点与处置效应
title_secondary: Recent stock prices as reference points and the disposition effect
authors: Julia Brettschneider, Giovanni Burro, Vicky Henderson
official: 官方在线 2026-09-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We quantify how the magnitude of the disposition effect changes when gains and losses are defined relative to recent stock prices rather than the original purchase price. Our study uses the LDB dataset containing trading records of individual investors. Using recent prices as the reference point lowers the disposition effect. This reduction is more pronounced for active traders. Our central finding is a monotonic increase in the disposition effect with price lag length. We observe a tendency to sell stocks that recently appreciated (depreciated) with respect to stocks that recently depreciated (appreciated) in the gain (loss) domain.
abstract_zh: 我们量化了当收益和损失是相对于近期股价而非原始购买价格来定义时，处置效应的大小如何变化。我们的研究使用包含个人投资者交易记录的LDB数据集。以近期价格作为参考点会降低处置效应。这种降低在活跃交易者中更为明显。我们的核心发现是，处置效应随价格滞后长度呈单调增加。我们观察到，在收益（损失）域中，相对于近期贬值（升值）的股票，存在卖出近期升值（贬值）股票的倾向。

title: Tracking Air Pollution from Space: High-Resolution Daily Estimates for PM2.5, O3, NO2, and CO
title_zh: 从太空追踪空气污染：PM2.5、O3、NO2和CO的高分辨率每日估算
title_primary: 从太空追踪空气污染：PM2.5、O3、NO2和CO的高分辨率每日估算
title_secondary: Tracking Air Pollution from Space: High-Resolution Daily Estimates for PM2.5, O3, NO2, and CO
authors: Blankespoor, Brian, Dasgupta, Susmita, Wheeler, David
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Air pollution imposes severe health and economic costs worldwide, yet ground-based monitoring data are difficult and expensive to collect, limiting the information available for policy analysis. This paper develops machine learning models to estimate daily air quality using satellite observations, meteorological data, emissions inventories, and geographic information. Data sources include IQAir ground station reports; atmospheric pollutant concentrations from the European Space Agency’s tropospheric monitoring instrument, TROPOMI; and meteorological data from the Copernicus ERA5 Land database. The paper estimates separate random forest models for fine particulate matter (PM2.5), ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and carbon monoxide, using a random forest algorithm that quantifies variable importance. The results are robust: TROPOMI dominates predictions for fine particulates (PM2.5), nitrogen dioxide, and carbon monoxide, with the Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research and meteorological variables providing secondary contributions. For ozone, the meteorological variables are most influential, followed by TROPOMI and the Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research. Geographic features matter across all pollutants—elevation, latitude, and coastal proximity consistently rank high, while Köppen-Geiger climate zones vary in importance by pollutant. Temporal tracking is validated by correlating daily monitored versus predicted pollutant levels across urban areas using IQAir ground station data. Median intertemporal correlations exceed 0.69 for all pollutants, with upper quartiles above 0.82 and lower quartiles above 0.53. Although the pilot uses data from April to November 2025, TROPOMI has been available since 2018 and the Copernicus ERA5 Land database provides matching coverage, enabling daily estimates from April 2018 onward on a global terrestrial grid at 0.1-degree resolution.
abstract_zh: 空气污染在全球范围内造成了严重的健康和经济成本，但地面监测数据难以且昂贵地收集，限制了可用于政策分析的信息。本文开发机器学习模型，利用卫星观测、气象数据、排放清单和地理信息来估算每日空气质量。数据来源包括IQAir地面站报告；欧洲航天局对流层监测仪器TROPOMI的大气污染物浓度；以及哥白尼ERA5 Land数据库的气象数据。本文使用可量化变量重要性的随机森林算法，分别为细颗粒物（PM2.5）、臭氧、二氧化氮和一氧化碳估算单独的随机森林模型。结果具有稳健性：TROPOMI在细颗粒物（PM2.5）、二氧化氮和一氧化碳的预测中占主导地位，全球大气研究排放数据库和气象变量提供次要贡献。对于臭氧，气象变量影响最大，其次是TROPOMI和全球大气研究排放数据库。地理特征对所有污染物都很重要——海拔、纬度和近海程度始终排名靠前，而柯本-盖格气候带的重要性因污染物而异。通过使用IQAir地面站数据将城市地区的每日监测污染物水平与预测污染物水平进行相关分析，验证了时间追踪能力。所有污染物的时间序列相关系数中位数均超过0.69，上四分位数高于0.82，下四分位数高于0.53。尽管该试点使用的是2025年4月至11月的数据，但TROPOMI自2018年以来一直可用，且哥白尼ERA5 Land数据库提供了匹配的覆盖范围，从而能够在全球陆地网格上以0.1度分辨率从2018年4月起进行每日估算。

title: The Macroeconomic Returns to School Finance Reforms: Micro-Calibrated Predictions Meet Causal Evidence
title_zh: 学校财政改革带来的宏观经济回报：微观校准预测与因果证据的结合
title_primary: 学校财政改革带来的宏观经济回报：微观校准预测与因果证据的结合
title_secondary: The Macroeconomic Returns to School Finance Reforms: Micro-Calibrated Predictions Meet Causal Evidence
authors: C. Kirabo Jackson
official: 官方在线 2026-09-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A large literature posits a central role for human capital in determining macroeconomic output, while another documents substantial private returns to educational investment. However, whether private gains translate into aggregate gains remains uncertain, as signaling, displacement, or general-equilibrium adjustment may drive a wedge between private and aggregate returns. This paper bridges these literatures with causal evidence that state-level school finance reforms (SFRs) increase macroeconomic output. First, I combine design-based micro estimates of SFR effects on private earnings with a cohort replacement framework to simulate state-level earnings per worker. The simulation predicts little change for 10 to 15 years, then gradual gains as treated cohorts enter the labor force, reaching 7.8 percent after 60 years. Next, I test this prediction using the staggered implementation of SFRs across U.S. states. In an event-study framework, state-level earnings per worker track the predicted path, remaining flat through about 15 years before rising roughly 4.7 percent above counterfactual levels after 30 years — consistent with private earnings gains aggregating to the broader economy. Finally, I show that these effects extend to broader economic output, with GDP per capita declining modestly initially before rising to more than 5 percent above its counterfactual path after 30 years.
abstract_zh: 大量文献主张人力资本在决定宏观经济产出中发挥核心作用，另有文献记录了教育投资的显著私人回报。然而，私人收益能否转化为总体收益仍不确定，因为信号传递、挤出效应或一般均衡调整可能在私人回报与总体回报之间造成楔子。本文通过州级学校财政改革（SFRs）提高宏观经济产出的因果证据，将这两支文献联系起来。首先，我将基于设计的SFR对私人收入影响的微观估计与队列替换框架相结合，以模拟州级人均劳动者收入。模拟预测在10至15年内变化不大，随后随着受处理队列进入劳动力市场而逐渐上升，60年后达到7.8%。接下来，我利用美国各州SFR的交错实施来检验这一预测。在事件研究框架中，州级人均劳动者收入遵循预测路径，在大约15年内保持平稳，30年后升至反事实水平以上约4.7%——这与私人收入收益加总到更广泛经济相一致。最后，我表明这些效应扩展到更广泛的经济产出，人均GDP最初温和下降，30年后升至其反事实路径以上超过5%。

title: Curtailing False News, Amplifying Truth
title_zh: 遏制虚假新闻，放大真相
title_primary: 遏制虚假新闻，放大真相
title_secondary: Curtailing False News, Amplifying Truth
authors: Guriev, Sergei, Emeric Henry, Théo Marquis, and Ekaterina Zhuravskaya
official: 官方在线 2026-09-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a comprehensive framework to evaluate policy interventions aimed at curbing false news dissemination on social media. Using a randomized experiment on Twitter and X during the 2022 and 2024 U.S. elections, we assess priming for misinformation awareness, fact‐checking, confirmation clicks, and content consideration prompts. Priming proves most effective in reducing false‐news sharing while preserving true news dissemination. We build and structurally estimate a model of sharing, motivated by partisan persuasion, partisan signaling, and reputational concerns. We identify three channels through which policies influence sharing: (i) updating perceived veracity and partisanship of content, (ii) raising salience of reputation, and (iii) increasing engagement costs. Differences in the effects of policies are explained by the salience and cost channels. Content‐neutral priming is best at enhancing salience of reputation at minimal cost and almost as effective as fact‐checking in updating veracity. Salience channel is stronger when users encounter uncontroversially true content.

title: Expected Utility Maximization and the Optimal Portfolio of Risky Assets
title_zh: 期望效用最大化与风险资产的最优投资组合
title_primary: 期望效用最大化与风险资产的最优投资组合
title_secondary: Expected Utility Maximization and the Optimal Portfolio of Risky Assets
authors: Karl Whelan
official: 官方在线 2026-09-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Classic finance theory advises investors to hold a mix of the risk-free asset and a single portfolio of risky assets: the tangency portfolio that maximizes the Sharpe ratio. Two questions about this ad- vice have remained largely unresolved. Is holding this specific portfolio approximately consistent with expected utility maximization? And if so, what determines how much of it to hold? Existing derivations typically assume either Normally distributed returns or quadratic utility. This paper answers both questions using a second-order expansion of a general concave utility function, without either restriction. The resulting portfolio is exactly proportional to the tangency portfolio, scaled by a term that depends on the maximum Sharpe ratio of the investment opportunity set. The approximation is highly accurate: a fourth-order correction, solved exactly for a two-asset opportunity set and numerically for a ten-asset one, changes portfolio composition only modestly, and the solution captures at least 95% of the achievable utility gain, relative to the numerically optimal CRRA portfolio, over a naive benchmark matched to the same overall risky/risk-free split.
abstract_zh: 经典金融理论建议投资者持有无风险资产与单一风险资产组合的混合：即最大化夏普比率的切点组合。关于这一建议的两个问题在很大程度上仍未解决。持有这一特定组合是否近似符合期望效用最大化？如果是，又是什么决定了应持有多少？现有推导通常假设收益呈正态分布或效用为二次型。本文利用一般凹效用函数的二阶展开回答这两个问题，且不施加上述任一限制。所得组合恰好与切点组合成比例，并按一个取决于投资机会集最大夏普比率的项进行缩放。该近似高度精确：对于两资产机会集精确求解、对于十资产机会集数值求解的四阶修正，仅温和改变组合构成，并且相对于在相同整体风险/无风险配置下匹配的朴素基准，该解至少捕捉到相对于数值最优CRRA组合可实现效用增益的95%。

abstract: We replicate the two foundational studies which proposed the two‐tier stochastic frontier model, first in the cross‐sectional setting and then for the fixed effects panel data model. We explore matters of software then and now, different mathematical formulations of the likelihood, and alternative current software tools. We also highlight several data issues that arose in both replications.

title: The rise of renewable energy: How it shapes dependency, diversity, and geopolitical risk in the European Union
title_zh: 可再生能源的崛起：如何塑造欧盟的依赖、多样性和地缘政治风险
title_primary: 可再生能源的崛起：如何塑造欧盟的依赖、多样性和地缘政治风险
title_secondary: The rise of renewable energy: How it shapes dependency, diversity, and geopolitical risk in the European Union
authors: Sulaman Muhammad, Christin Hoffmann, Felix Müsgens
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As the European Union advances its shift toward cleaner energy to address climate challenges, a pressing question emerges: can this shift also strengthen energy security in an increasingly volatile global landscape? This study investigates the impact of renewable energy on energy security risks across 27 EU countries over the period 2010 to 2022. It measures energy security through three key dimensions—energy dependency risk, energy diversity risk, and geopolitical risk. The findings reveal that renewable energy significantly mitigates energy diversity risk and geopolitical risk across the EU. However, its impact on energy dependency risk is statistically insignificant in the overall sample. Notably, further non-linear analyses show that in countries with higher levels of renewable energy deployment, renewables significantly reduce dependency risk on foreign energy sources. This highlights the importance of reaching a critical threshold of renewable integration to unlock broader energy security benefits.
abstract_zh: 随着欧盟为应对气候挑战而推进向清洁能源的转型，一个紧迫的问题随之浮现：在日益动荡的全球格局下，这一转型能否同时增强能源安全？本研究考察了2010年至2022年间可再生能源对27个欧盟国家能源安全风险的影响。研究从三个关键维度衡量能源安全——能源依赖风险、能源多样性风险和地缘政治风险。研究结果表明，可再生能源显著缓解了欧盟整体的能源多样性风险和地缘政治风险。然而，在总体样本中，其对能源依赖风险的影响在统计上不显著。值得注意的是，进一步的非线性分析表明，在可再生能源部署水平较高的国家，可再生能源显著降低了对外部能源来源的依赖风险。这凸显了达到可再生能源整合临界门槛以释放更广泛能源安全效益的重要性。

title: Comparative Advantage in AI-Intensive Industries: Evidence from US Imports
title_zh: 人工智能密集型产业的比较优势：来自美国进口的证据
title_primary: 人工智能密集型产业的比较优势：来自美国进口的证据
title_secondary: Comparative Advantage in AI-Intensive Industries: Evidence from US Imports
authors: Alessandra Bonfiglioli, Rosario Crinò, Mattia Filomena, Gino Gancia
official: 官方在线 2025-01-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the sources of comparative advantage in data-intensive industries using a comprehensive dataset of US imports from 69 countries across 79 manufacturing and service industries over the period 1999–2023. Using a novel measure of data intensity based on the prevalence of occupations requiring expertise in machine learning and data analysis, we identify key factors influencing exports. Our analysis shows that countries with larger STEM graduate populations, broader Internet penetration and larger export scale exhibit stronger export performance in data-intensive industries. In contrast, regulatory barriers to digital trade are associated with lower data-intensive exports. These results are robust to controlling for traditional sources of comparative advantage and addressing potential threats to identification. Our findings have implications for understanding competitiveness in the digital economy and highlight that fostering capabilities in data-driven industries may be particularly important due to their pronounced scale economies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1999年至2023年间美国从69个国家进口涵盖79个制造业和服务业行业的全面数据集，探究数据密集型产业比较优势的来源。通过一种基于机器学习与数据分析专长职业普及程度的新型数据密集度衡量指标，我们识别出影响出口的关键因素。分析显示，STEM毕业生人口规模更大、互联网普及率更广及出口规模更大的国家，在数据密集型产业中展现出更强的出口表现。相反，数字贸易的监管壁垒与较低的数据密集型出口相关联。这些结果在控制传统比较优势来源并应对潜在识别威胁后依然稳健。我们的发现对理解数字经济中的竞争力具有启示意义，并强调由于数据驱动产业显著的规模经济效应，培育相关能力可能尤为重要。

title: Sovereign Debt Restructurings: Preemptive or Post-Default
title_zh: 主权债务重组：预防性还是违约后
title_primary: 主权债务重组：预防性还是违约后
title_secondary: Sovereign Debt Restructurings: Preemptive or Post-Default
authors: Tamon Asonuma, Christoph Trebesch
official: 官方在线 2015-11-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Sovereign debt restructurings can be implemented preemptively - prior to a payment default. We code a comprehensive new dataset and find that preemptive restructurings (i) are frequent (38% of all deals 1978-2010), (ii) have lower haircuts, (iii) are quicker to negotiate, and (iv) see lower output losses. To rationalize these stylized facts, we build a quantitative sovereign debt model that incorporates preemptive and post-default renegotiations. The model improves the fit with the data and explains the sovereign's optimal choice: preemptive restructurings occur when default risk is high ex-ante, while defaults occur after unexpected bad shocks. Empirical evidence supports these predictions.
abstract_zh: 主权债务重组可以在支付违约之前以预防性方式实施。我们编制了一个全面的新数据集，并发现预防性重组（i）频繁发生（占1978-2010年间所有交易的38%），（ii）具有较低的减记幅度，（iii）谈判速度更快，且（iv）产出损失较小。为合理化这些典型事实，我们构建了一个量化主权债务模型，该模型整合了预防性与违约后重新谈判。模型改善了与数据的拟合度，并解释了主权国家的最优选择：当事前违约风险较高时，预防性重组发生；而违约则是在意外负面冲击之后出现。实证证据支持这些预测。

title: DP19312 Correlation in State and Local Tax Changes
title_zh: 州与地方税收变动的相关性
title_primary: 州与地方税收变动的相关性
title_secondary: DP19312 Correlation in State and Local Tax Changes
authors: Scott Baker, Pawel Janas, Lorenz Kueng
official: 官方在线 2024-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical research in public economics, including our own, often uses variation in state and local taxes as an empirical laboratory to estimate causal relationships. A key concern is that other taxes might change at the same time. To assess this concern, we develop a dataset of state (1977-2022) and local (2000-2022) tax rates and revenue from personal income, corporate income, property, sales, and excise taxes. This new dataset generates two key results. First, we find that taxes of different types tend to co-move within a jurisdiction: a tax change of one type can more than double the likelihood of a second tax type changing in the same year. Local tax changes also co-move with tax changes enacted by the state they are located in. This positive correlation can upwardly bias elasticity estimates, but only moderately. For example, regressing state economic outcomes on the full set of state tax changes yields elasticities that are about 10-30% smaller than those obtained from using a single tax type in isolation. Second, we document that the mix of taxes across state and local jurisdictions is very different, and that these differences have become more pronounced over time as jurisdictions have increasingly become reliant on the single tax type - sales, personal or corporate income tax - that was most prominent for them in the earliest part of our sample.
abstract_zh: 公共经济学中的实证研究，包括我们自己的研究，常常利用州和地方税收的变化作为实证实验室来估计因果关系。一个关键的担忧是，其他税种可能同时发生变化。为了评估这一担忧，我们构建了一个涵盖州（1977-2022年）和地方（2000-2022年）税率及来自个人所得税、公司所得税、财产税、销售税和消费税收入的数据集。这一新数据集产生了两个关键结果。首先，我们发现不同类型的税收往往在同一辖区内共同变动：一种税种的变化可能使另一种税种在同一年发生变化的可能性增加一倍以上。地方税收变化也与其所在州实施的税收变化共同变动。这种正相关性可能会向上偏误弹性估计，但幅度有限。例如，将州经济结果对所有州税收变化进行回归，得到的弹性比仅使用单一税种时小约10-30%。其次，我们记录了州和地方辖区之间的税收组合差异显著，且随着时间推移，这些差异变得更加明显，因为辖区越来越依赖于单一税种——销售税、个人所得税或公司所得税——这些税种在我们样本初期对它们而言最为突出。

title: Geopolitical risk exposure and resilience of energy support-chain trade: A multilayer network diagnosis
title_zh: 地缘政治风险暴露与能源支撑链贸易韧性：多层网络诊断

authors: Baojun Tang, Chongzhou Wang, Meng Shen, Yun Wu, Peiyun Xu 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a fragmenting international order, geopolitical risks increasingly affect the trade relationships that supply equipment, materials and functional inputs for energy transitions, raising concerns about the stability, substitutability and recoverability of upstream support-chain access. This study examines the energy support chain, comprising processing and synthesis equipment, mining, power generation and transmission equipment, and other energy sources and additives, whose trade relationships may themselves become structurally vulnerable under geopolitical-risk exposure. To diagnose how risk exposure is associated with instability and vulnerability in this chain, we extend the Trade–Resilience–Energy–Network Diagnosis for Supply framework by integrating a multilayer trade network with a country-year Energy-related Geopolitical Risk Exposure index, trade-relationship volatility, Support-chain Trade Accessibility Vulnerability and multi-node deletion and recovery stress tests. Using 2008–2023 bilateral trade data for 166 economies, we build a multilayer support-chain trade network, track sub-industry evolution and identify cross-layer hubs via node-deletion sensitivity. The results provide network-diagnostic evidence for identifying vulnerable trade relationships, critical hubs and recovery priorities under geopolitical uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 在国际秩序日益碎片化的背景下，地缘政治风险日益影响为能源转型提供设备、材料和功能性投入的贸易关系，引发了对上游支撑链获取的稳定性、可替代性和可恢复性的担忧。本研究考察能源支撑链，其涵盖加工与合成设备、采矿、发电与输电设备以及其他能源来源和添加剂，这些贸易关系本身可能在地缘政治风险暴露下变得结构脆弱。为诊断风险暴露如何与该链中的不稳定性和脆弱性相关联，我们扩展了供应链贸易—韧性—能源—网络诊断框架，将多层贸易网络与国别—年度能源相关地缘政治风险暴露指数、贸易关系波动性、支撑链贸易可及性脆弱性以及多节点删除与恢复压力测试相结合。利用2008—2023年166个经济体的双边贸易数据，我们构建了一个多层支撑链贸易网络，追踪子行业演变，并通过节点删除敏感性识别跨层枢纽。研究结果为在地缘政治不确定性下识别脆弱贸易关系、关键枢纽和恢复优先事项提供了网络诊断证据。

abstract: How do we evaluate the welfare gains from transport infrastructure investment? We present a quantitative spatial framework that integrates traffic and economic responses to infrastructure improvements and derives the elasticity of aggregate welfare to changes in the transportation network. The resulting formula extends the traditional ``social savings'' method to incorporate route and mode choice, agglomeration and dispersion externalities, and traffic congestion. We apply the formula to the U.S. freight network and assess the benefits of reducing costs on each segment of the U.S. Interstate Highway System. The traditional and extended measures are closely related overall, but they differ in the level of estimated gains and in the ranking of some highly valued links. Where the rankings differ, network position determines how congestion and spatial adjustment alter a link's measured benefit.
abstract_zh: 我们如何评估交通基础设施投资的福利收益？我们提出一个定量空间框架，该框架整合了交通与基础设施改善的经济响应，并推导出总体福利对交通网络变化的弹性。由此得出的公式扩展了传统的“社会节约”方法，纳入了路线与模式选择、集聚与分散外部性以及交通拥堵因素。我们将该公式应用于美国货运网络，并评估了减少美国州际公路系统各路段成本所带来的收益。传统度量与扩展度量总体密切相关，但在估计收益水平及某些高价值路段的排序上存在差异。在排序不同的地方，网络位置决定了拥堵和空间调整如何改变路段的测量收益。

abstract: We estimate the peer effects of paternity leave‐taking among male co‐workers using the 2006 Quebec paternity leave reform. Using high‐quality administrative data, we closely follow the birth date regression discontinuity research design of Dahl et al. (2014) who studied a similar reform in Norway in 1993 which resembles the Quebec reform. Depending on the length of follow‐up, we estimate that having a male co‐worker take paternity leave increases the probability that a father of a newborn takes leave by 3 to 6 percentage points. While the statistical significance of our findings differ from Dahl et al. (2014) using Norwegian data, these estimates are nevertheless consistent with the 11 percentage point increase they report.

abstract: GLP-1 drugs have transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity. As governments and insurers debate whether and how to cover GLP-1 drugs, much of the discussion focuses on health spending. But obesity and diabetes also impose costs through the labour market. Using linked Danish register data, this column examines whether people are more likely to work after beginning treatment and spend less time away because of illness. The findings reveal that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave, as well as emergency department visits and cardiovascular medication use.

abstract: In his 1958 classic, The Theory of Committees and Elections, Duncan Black proposes the following lexicographic choice rule: for any set of feasible candidates, and any profile of voters’ preference relations, choose the strong Condorcet winner if it exists, and select the set of Borda winners otherwise. We provide a novel axiomatic characterization of this proposal. We do so by means of the social welfare functions that underlie the rule’s choices, and the use of axioms that emphasize what is common and what is different in the spirit of the amply debated proposals made by these two eighteenth-century authors.
abstract_zh: 在邓肯·布莱克1958年的经典著作《委员会与选举理论》中，他提出了以下字典序选择规则：对于任何可行的候选人集合及任何选民偏好关系分布，若存在强孔多塞赢家，则选择之；否则，选取博尔达赢家集合。我们对此提议提供了一种新颖的公理化特征描述。我们通过支撑该规则选择的社会福利函数，并运用强调这两位十八世纪作者广泛讨论提案中共同点与差异点的公理来实现这一目标。

title: How Much Information Should Interest Rate-Setting Central Banks Reveal?
title_zh: 利率设定的中央银行应披露多少信息？

authors: Charles Wyplosz, Aileen Gosselin-Lotz, Pierre Gosselin
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Morris and Shin (2002) have shown that a central bank may be too transparent if the private sector pays too much attention to its possible imprecise signals simply because they are common knowledge. In their model, the central bank faces a binary choice: to reveal or not to reveal its information. This paper extends their model to the more realistic case where the central bank must anyway convey some information by setting the interest rate. This situation radically changes the conclusions. In many cases, full transparency is socially optimal. In other instances the central bank can distill information to either manipulate private sector expectations in a way that reduces the common knowledge effect or to reduce the unavoidable information content of the interest rate. In no circumstance is the option of only setting the interest rate socially optimal.
abstract_zh: Morris与Shin（2002）的研究表明，当私人部门过度关注央行可能不精确的信号（仅因其具有共同知识属性）时，央行透明度可能过高。在其模型中，央行面临二元选择：披露或不披露信息。本文将该模型拓展至更现实的场景——央行必须通过设定利率来传递信息。这一情境从根本上改变了原有结论。在许多情况下，完全透明是社会最优选择；在其他情形下，央行可通过信息提炼来操纵私人部门预期（以降低共同知识效应），或减少利率不可避免的信息含量。在任何情况下，仅设定利率的选项均非社会最优。

title: Extreme return connectedness among gambling tokens, gambling ETFs, and other assets: the role of global uncertainties and portfolio implications
title_zh: 赌博代币、赌博ETF及其他资产的极端收益关联性：全球不确定性的作用与投资组合影响

authors: Chin Man Chui, Han Yang, Peixiu Chen, Ifran Khan, Cody Yu-Ling Hsiao

abstract: This study investigates return spillovers among gambling tokens, gambling exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and traditional financial assets using a Quantile Vector Autoregression (QVAR) framework, while evaluating portfolio diversification strategies and the role of global uncertainties. Empirical results demonstrate that connectedness across these markets intensifies significantly at extreme quantiles of the return distribution compared to median quantiles, indicating that gambling tokens function as effective diversifiers under normal market conditions. However, their diversification efficacy attenuates during periods of economic turmoil. Notably, gambling tokens exhibit robust tail risk mitigation during market downturns and recovery phases. Dynamic portfolios incorporating these tokens outperform static buy-and-hold strategies in risk management. Furthermore, Wavelet Quantile Regression (WQR) analysis reveals heterogeneous impacts of global uncertainties on return connectedness, with effects contingent on market conditions and time horizons. Specifically, uncertainty-driven spillovers are most pronounced during bearish regimes and at longer time scales. These findings underscore the importance of adaptive portfolio strategies and provide critical insights for investors seeking to balance diversification benefits with tail-risk resilience in an increasingly interconnected global financial market.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用分位数向量自回归（QVAR）框架，考察博彩代币、博彩交易所交易基金（ETF）与传统金融资产之间的收益溢出效应，同时评估投资组合多元化策略及全球不确定性的作用。实证结果表明，相较于中位数分位数，这些市场在收益分布的极端分位数处关联性显著增强，表明博彩代币在正常市场条件下可作为有效的多元化工具。然而，在经济动荡时期，其多元化效能有所减弱。值得注意的是，博彩代币在市场下行及复苏阶段展现出稳健的尾部风险缓释能力。纳入这些代币的动态投资组合在风险管理方面优于静态买入持有策略。此外，小波分位数回归（WQR）分析揭示了全球不确定性对收益关联性的异质性影响，其效应取决于市场状况与时间跨度。具体而言，不确定性驱动的溢出效应在熊市阶段及较长周期内最为显著。这些发现凸显了适应性投资组合策略的重要性，并为投资者在日益互联的全球金融市场中平衡多元化收益与尾部风险韧性提供了关键启示。

abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜费用，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利通常包含较低的年度限额。本研究考察了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响——该群体视力损伤、患病率和残疾率均较高。基于2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据，采用双重差分法，我们估算出医疗补助常规视力福利使过去一年眼科检查率、眼镜购买量及医疗补助眼镜支出增加，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现存在向医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出的溢出效应证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使已享有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保人额外购买眼镜的现象一致，尽管估算结果较为温和。

abstract: This paper examines historical black-white disparities in wealth and economic mobility using linked census records. First, we compare black and white men’s mobility into property ownership between 1870, the first census taken after the Civil War, and 1900. Conditional on not owning property in 1870, black men’s mobility rate was far lower than white men’s. Equal mobility rates would have nearly closed the black-white home ownership gap in 1900. Second, we show that black men located in cotton-intensive counties in 1870 were far less likely to attain home ownership than black men located elsewhere. This difference is consistent across national samples and samples restricted to the former Confederacy, with and without controls; it is also evident in IV estimates. The pattern is connected to the prevalence of sharecropping and high black population shares. For white men, the difference in upward mobility between cotton-intensive and other areas was much smaller and less robust. Many black households acquired land and homes of their own in this era, an important channel for economic advance. Yet their geographic concentration in areas with fewer opportunities to acquire property implied low aggregate rates of upward mobility.

abstract: This study develops a multi-layer local Gaussian correlation network approach to examine crisis-specific commodity – inflation linkages across the G7 and E7 economies. The empirical results show that mean inflation correlations between the E7 and G7 are lower than within-group correlations, suggesting differences in inflation co-movements between advanced and emerging economies. Energy – inflation linkages are generally stronger than both cross-country inflation linkages and agricultural commodity – inflation associations, with all correlations rising noticeably during major global crises. These patterns also display clear quantile heterogeneity. At the low inflation quantile, commodity – inflation linkages are relatively broad-based across the G7 and E7 economies, whereas they become denser and more concentrated at higher inflation quantiles. Major crises also reshape the network structure in distinct ways. The 2008 crisis is marked by the central role of agricultural commodities, the COVID-19 pandemic by a more balanced energy – agriculture pattern, and the 2022 Russia – Ukraine war by the prominence of the Russia – natural gas linkage. Overall, the results suggest that commodity – inflation linkages are shaped jointly by inflation regimes, commodity characteristics, and crisis-specific structural shocks. The findings also provide useful implications for policymakers in designing tailored response strategies that take account of quantile-dependent risks and event-driven vulnerabilities in global commodity markets.

abstract: This paper introduces the Euro Area Communication Event-Study Database (EA-CED), a new dataset tracking intraday financial market movements around 304 ECB Governing Council meetings (ECBGC) and 5100 inter-meeting communication (IMC) events by GC members, primarily in the form of speeches and interviews. We document that IMC events are associated with significant market movements often comparable to, or larger than, those following ECB policy announcements, particularly for longer maturity yields. Importantly, these effects are not limited to communication from the ECB President but also from other Governing Council members. Like ECBGC announcements, IMC events convey multidimensional information: three structurally identified factors explain a large share of the yield curve movements around IMC surprises. Finally, we show that IMC events provide relevant information for identifying the effects of monetary policy shocks on euro area output and inflation in a Bayesian Vector Autoregression model.

abstract: Digital money differs from previous forms of money in an important way: it unbundles trust. Instead of relying on a trustworthy institution to settle payments, it relies on decentralized verification, whose cost is priced separately through congestion-sensitive gas fees. This arrangement creates a novel fragility from the interaction of two opposing forces: network externalities, which make digital money more valuable as adoption rises, and congestion fees, which make it more costly to use. We show that these forces generate strategic complementarities in redemption decisions and can create runs even when digital money is backed by perfectly safe reserves.
abstract_zh: 数字货币与以往货币形式的一个关键区别在于：它将信任解绑。数字货币不再依赖可信机构进行支付结算，而是依靠去中心化验证，其成本通过拥堵敏感型的燃料费单独定价。这种机制因两种对立力量的相互作用而产生了一种新型脆弱性：网络外部性使数字货币随采用率上升而增值，而拥堵费则提高了使用成本。我们证明，这些力量会在赎回决策中产生战略互补性，即便数字货币由完全安全的储备资产支持，也可能引发挤兑。

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted labour markets globally, intensifying inequalities and reshaping employment structures. In Vietnam, migrants who relocated in search of a higher income were disproportionately affected, and non-migrant workers faced distinct challenges. Using data from the Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey 2018–2022, this study applies propensity score matching to investigate the effect of migration on labour income. Although migrant workers earned more than non-migrant workers, they experienced greater income volatility during the pandemic and recovery periods. Stratified analyses revealed the diverse effects of migration on income. Although the pandemic created short-term job opportunities that were more accessible to migrants owing to their specific characteristics, the surge in demand was temporary. In the post-pandemic period, labour market conditions returned to normal, and a gradual transition towards automation and digitalization shifted labour demand in favour of more skilled and digitally literate workers. Consequently, migration benefits have become more pronounced for high-school graduates than for less-educated individuals. These findings highlight the importance of policies that promote lifelong learning and employment protection alongside investments in education, vocational training, and digital access. Such measures are essential for building adaptive, inclusive, and resilient labour markets.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情扰乱了全球劳动力市场，加剧了不平等并重塑了就业结构。在越南，为寻求更高收入而迁移的移民受到了不成比例的影响，而非移民工人则面临独特的挑战。本研究利用2018至2022年越南家庭生活标准调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配法考察迁移对劳动收入的影响。尽管移民工人的收入高于非移民工人，但在疫情期间及恢复阶段，他们经历了更大的收入波动。分层分析揭示了迁移对收入的多重影响。尽管疫情创造了短期就业机会，由于移民的特定特征，这些机会对他们更为可及，但需求的激增是暂时的。疫情后时期，劳动力市场条件恢复正常，向自动化和数字化的逐步转型使劳动力需求转向更倾向于技能更高和数字素养更强的工人。因此，迁移带来的收益对高中毕业生而言比教育程度较低者更为显著。这些发现强调了促进终身学习和就业保障政策的重要性，同时需加大对教育、职业培训和数字接入的投资。此类措施对于构建适应性、包容性和韧性的劳动力市场至关重要。

abstract: This study examines how the expansion of public childcare is associated with the exit dynamics of existing childcare facilities in South Korea. Using comprehensive facility-level data covering all operating and closed childcare centres, we estimate fixed-effects models with lagged entry variables. Newly established public childcare centres are associated with a significant increase in exits among non-public facilities, whereas public facilities are largely unaffected by new public entry. We interpret this pattern as evidence that public expansion restructures local childcare markets. This market adjustment is not necessarily welfare-reducing: public expansion may improve affordability, accessibility, and service quality even as it changes the provider mix. Our findings therefore suggest that evaluations of public childcare expansion should consider both the benefits of public provision and the ownership-specific adjustment pressures that arise in local childcare markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了韩国公共托育服务的扩展与现有托育设施退出动态之间的关联。利用涵盖所有运营中及已关闭托育中心的全面设施层面数据，我们估计了包含滞后进入变量的固定效应模型。新设立的公共托育中心与非公共设施退出率显著增加相关，而公共设施则基本不受新公共进入的影响。我们将这一模式解读为公共扩展重塑了地方托育市场的证据。这种市场调整未必会降低福利：公共扩展可能改善可负担性、可及性和服务质量，即便它改变了提供者结构。因此，我们的研究结果表明，对公共托育扩展的评估应同时考虑公共供给的益处以及地方托育市场中因所有权特定调整压力而产生的影响。

abstract: We introduce a new, powerful, and easy-to-use solution concept called simple forward induction which is implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender signaling games. We apply this concept to infinite monotonic signaling games and show that a unique simple forward induction outcome exists and is non-distorted by asymmetric information. We also show that, in this class of games, the non-distorted outcome is the limit of stable outcomes of finite games. Hence, in this sense, we characterize stable outcomes in this class of games. The definition of our solution concept can be easily extended to arbitrary extensive-form games.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖、强大且易于使用的解概念，称为简单前向归纳法，该概念在一般有限多发送者信号博弈中由策略稳定性所蕴含。我们将这一概念应用于无限单调信号博弈，并证明存在唯一的简单前向归纳结果，且该结果不受信息不对称的扭曲。我们还证明，在此类博弈中，非扭曲结果是有限博弈稳定结果的极限。因此，在此意义上，我们刻画了此类博弈中的稳定结果。我们的解概念定义可轻松推广至任意扩展式博弈。

title: Cognition behind land transactions: How diverse forest value orientations shape willingness, price expectations, and forestland transfer behavior in rural China

abstract: Forestland transfer has been promoted as a key policy instrument to address severe parcelization and improve management efficiency. However, in China, despite long-standing policy support, actual transfer rates remain persistently low. While existing research attributes this to institutional and economic barriers, little is known about how smallholders’ subjective perceptions of forest values influence their market participation. This study examines how forest value orientations (FVOs), defined as smallholders’ perceived importance of different forest functions, shape their willingness, price expectations, and actual behaviors regarding forestland transfers. Using household-level data collected from timber-forest farmers across several provinces in southern China, exploratory factor analysis identifies three distinct value dimensions: ecological, economic, and emotional-symbolic. Binary Logit, Heckman two-step, and Cragg double-hurdle models are applied to estimate their effects on willingness-to-transfer, willingness-to-pay (WTP), willingness-to-accept (WTA), and realized transactions. Results show that ecological values significantly inhibit both transfer willingness and participation, likely reflecting the public-good nature and management burdens of ecologically valuable forests. In contrast, economic values promote active market engagement and narrow the WTA–WTP gap by aligning expectations with market benchmarks. Emotional-symbolic values, though less influential overall, positively affect transfer intentions, reflecting their role as private, exchangeable benefits under China’s temporary transfer arrangements. The findings highlight that subjective forest value perceptions critically shape market participation and price formation. Recognizing these heterogeneous value orientations can help policymakers design more nuanced, value-sensitive interventions to foster efficient and culturally appropriate forestland markets.
abstract_zh: 林地流转已被作为应对严重细碎化问题、提升管理效率的关键政策工具加以推广。然而，在中国，尽管政策支持由来已久，实际流转率仍持续偏低。现有研究多将此归因于制度性与经济性障碍，但关于小农户对森林价值的主观认知如何影响其市场参与，学界知之甚少。本研究考察森林价值取向（FVOs）——即小农户对不同森林功能重要性的主观感知——如何塑造其林地流转意愿、价格预期及实际行为。利用来自中国南方多个省份用材林农户的家庭层面数据，探索性因子分析识别出三个不同的价值维度：生态价值、经济价值和情感—象征价值。本研究采用二元Logit模型、Heckman两步法和Cragg双重门槛模型，估计这些价值维度对流转意愿、支付意愿（WTP）、受偿意愿（WTA）及实际交易的影响。结果表明，生态价值显著抑制流转意愿和参与行为，这可能反映了生态价值较高林地的公共物品属性及管理负担。相比之下，经济价值促进积极的市场参与，并通过使预期与市场基准趋同而缩小WTA–WTP差距。情感—象征价值虽总体影响较弱，但对流转意向产生正向作用，反映出其在中国临时性流转安排下作为私人性、可交换收益的角色。研究结果凸显，主观森林价值感知对市场参与和价格形成具有关键塑造作用。识别这些异质性价值取向，有助于政策制定者设计更具针对性和价值敏感性的干预措施，以促进高效且符合文化情境的林地市场发展。

abstract: When in proxy-SVARs the covariance matrix of VAR disturbances is subject to exogenous, permanent breaks that cause IRFs to change across volatility regimes, even strong, exogenous external instruments yield inconsistent estimates of the dynamic causal effects. However, if these volatility shifts are properly incorporated into the analysis through (testable) “stability restrictions”, we demonstrate that the target IRFs are point-identified and can be estimated consistently under a necessary and sufficient rank condition. If the shifts in volatility are sufficiently informative, standard asymptotic inference remains valid even with (i) local-to-zero covariance between the proxies and the instrumented structural shocks, and (ii) potential failures of instrument exogeneity. Intuitively, shifts in volatility act similarly to strong instruments that are correlated with both the target and non-target shocks. We illustrate the effectiveness of our approach by revisiting a seminal fiscal proxy-SVAR for the US economy. We detect a sharp change in the size of the tax multiplier when the narrative tax instrument is complemented with the decline in unconditional volatility observed during the transition from the Great Inflation to the Great Moderation. The narrative tax instrument contributes to identify the tax shock in both regimes, although our empirical analysis raises concerns about its statistical validity. Supplementary materials for this article are available online.
abstract_zh: 在代理结构向量自回归（proxy-SVAR）中，当VAR扰动的协方差矩阵受到外生的永久性突变影响，从而导致脉冲响应函数（IRFs）在不同波动率区制间发生变化时，即便是强而外生的外部工具变量也会产生动态因果效应的不一致估计。然而，若通过（可检验的）“稳定性约束”将这些波动率变动恰当地纳入分析，我们证明目标IRFs是可点识别的，并可在必要且充分的秩条件下得到一致估计。若波动率的变动具有足够的信息含量，则即便存在以下情形，标准渐近推断仍然有效：(i) 代理变量与被工具化的结构冲击之间的协方差为局部趋于零；(ii) 工具外生性可能失效。直观而言，波动率的变动所起的作用类似于与目标冲击和非目标冲击均相关的强工具变量。我们通过重新审视一个关于美国经济的经典财政代理SVAR来展示本方法的有效性。当叙事性税收工具与在大通胀向大缓和过渡期间所观察到的无条件波动率下降相结合时，我们检测到税收乘数大小发生了急剧变化。叙事性税收工具在两个区制中都有助于识别税收冲击，尽管我们的实证分析对其统计有效性提出了担忧。本文的补充材料可在线获取。

abstract: China has long faced the persistent challenge of low household consumption and high savings rates. This paper empirically examines the impact of illegal fundraising on household savings rate using data from criminal court cases of illegal fundraising and three waves of the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS). The results indicate that illegal fundraising significantly increases household savings, with happiness and risk attitudes being the transmission mechanisms. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the effect of illegal fundraising on household savings rate is more pronounced among middle-aged and elderly groups, individuals with lower educational attainment, and regions with higher levels of digital financial inclusion. This study provides a new perspective and robust evidence for a deeper understanding of Chinese households’ consumption and savings behaviour, offering further insights to stimulate consumer potential.
abstract_zh: 中国长期面临居民消费低迷与高储蓄率的持续挑战。本文利用非法集资刑事案件数据与三期中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）数据，实证检验了非法集资对家庭储蓄率的影响。结果表明，非法集资显著提高了家庭储蓄，幸福感和风险态度是其中的传导机制。异质性分析发现，非法集资对家庭储蓄率的影响在中老年群体、受教育程度较低的人群以及数字普惠金融水平较高的地区更为明显。本研究为深入理解中国家庭的消费与储蓄行为提供了新视角和稳健证据，也为激发消费潜力提供了进一步启示。

abstract: Abstract Men’s historical advantage in educational attainment has recently been reversed in many countries. I study the implications for family formation of the new female advantage in education in the marriage market, exploiting a Finnish school reform that increased women’s relative level of education. I analyze the reduced-form relationship between marriage market exposure to the reform and family outcomes. I find decreases in marriage and fertility in marriage markets with a larger female educational advantage. These results are mostly driven by the mismatch between the educational distributions of men and women, and might have negative consequences for low-educated men’s mental health.
abstract_zh: 摘要 男性在教育程度上的历史优势近年来在许多国家已被逆转。本文利用芬兰一项提升女性相对教育水平的学校改革，研究了婚姻市场中女性教育新优势对家庭形成的影响。我分析了婚姻市场受改革影响程度与家庭结果之间的简化形式关系。研究发现，在女性教育优势较大的婚姻市场中，结婚率和生育率有所下降。这些结果主要由男女教育分布的不匹配所驱动，并可能对低教育水平男性的心理健康产生负面影响。

title: Inference for Regression with Variables Generated by AI or Machine Learning

authors: Laura Battaglia, Tim Christensen, Stephen Hansen, Szymon Sacher
official: 官方在线 2024-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: It has become common practice for researchers to use AI-powered information retrieval algorithms or other machine learning methods to estimate variables of economic interest, then use these estimates as covariates in a regression model. We show both theoretically and empirically that naively treating AI- and ML-generated variables as “data” leads to biased estimates and invalid inference. We propose two methods to correct bias and perform valid inference: (i) an explicit bias correction with bias-corrected confidence intervals, and (ii) joint maximum likelihood estimation of the regression model and the variables of interest. Through several applications, we demonstrate that the common approach generates substantial bias, while both corrections perform well.
abstract_zh: 研究者普遍采用人工智能驱动的信息检索算法或其他机器学习方法估算经济变量，随后将这些估算值作为回归模型中的协变量。我们通过理论与实证分析表明，若将人工智能与机器学习生成的变量简单视为"数据"，将导致有偏估计与无效推断。为此提出两种修正偏差并实现有效推断的方法：（i）采用显式偏差校正法构建偏差校正置信区间；（ii）对回归模型与目标变量进行联合极大似然估计。通过多项应用验证，常规方法会产生显著偏差，而两种修正方法均表现良好。
